text:
Ana M.: heads-up — BlueHarbor reporting elevated embedding latency over the last 30m, P1 SLA risk. Customer dashboards show p99 embeddings ~2.1s (normally ~200ms). Can anyone pick ownership?
Mike B.: I can take initial triage. any hint if this is model-related or infra?
Ana M.: Grafana looks like a tail at the inference tier, not network. rolling increase in CPU on pool-b-embeds nodes.
Sarah L.: tagging @Raj P. — he owns the Dedicated routing changes we rolled yesterday.
Raj P.: saw the deploy. I’m checking canary logs now. quick note: we switched KV cache config for embeddings to `kv_cache_enabled=false` in that rollout.
Olivia C.: if KV cache is off that would explain token decode work per-request. we toggled that to avoid a correctness regression last week.
Mike B.: can we toggle it back as a stopgap? what’s the risk?
Raj P.: risk is potential memory blowup for some long-context customers; BlueHarbor uses short contexts. I think safe to flip for their pool only. will need oncall-sre approval.
oncall-sre: please run `rb toggle-kv-cache --pool pool-b-embeds --enable true --dry-run=false` after review. allocated window?
Ana M.: BlueHarbor agrees to a 10m maintenance window now.
Mike B.: OK PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/642 — small flag change + healthcheck. requesting fast-review @Sarah L. @Olivia C.
Sarah L.: reviewing now. test plan: 5m canary, monitor p99, fallback to previous config if errors > 0.5%.
Olivia C.: good. I’ll stand by to revert if we see memory spikes.
deploy-bot: deploy launched by Mike B. — canary started on pool-b-embeds/canary-3 (ops id: dpl-9843).
Mike B.: canary metrics: p99 down to 210ms after toggle. no errors in canary logs.
Ana M.: amazing — if canary stable for 5m, roll to remaining hosts in pool-b-embeds. Raj, do you want to run the rollout?
Raj P.: starting rolling update now. commands: `rb rollout pool-b-embeds --config kv_cache=true --batch-size 3`
deploy-bot: rollout progress: 3/12 hosts updated — no service alerts.
Olivia C.: monitoring memory RSS across hosts. all clear so far.
Mike B.: customer Slack got a confirmation ping: "We applied a targeted config change, performance should improve. We're monitoring."
Ana M.: timeline: detection -> canary -> full roll = 18m. please add follow-up ticket for re-evaluating the cache toggle in long-term fix (possible invariant tweak).
Sarah L.: created ticket INF-8702: "BlueHarbor embedding cache regression root cause & safe default" and assigned to Raj.
Raj P.: will own INF-8702, ETA for investigation: EOD tomorrow.
oncall-sre: noted. closing on-call action once post-rollout metrics stay stable for 30m.
Mike B.: metrics looking good at +12m post-rollout; p99 stable ~230ms. no errors.
Ana M.: thanks all. BlueHarbor rep said "thanks, performance back to expected range". I’ll follow up with CS and include the PR + ticket. owners: Raj = RCA + permanent fix, Mike = immediate mitigation, Sarah = verification, Olivia = revert guard.
Ana M.: closing thread — will reopen if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
